title: GTA 6
PRE-LOAD
slides.sub: Pre-load opens November 10. Save this so you're ready.

slides.head: Pre-order the digital version
slides.body: Digital pre-loading opens November 10 on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Code-in-box copies should reach stores starting November 12.

slides.head: Free up 212 GB
slides.body: Rockstar says the pre-load needs up to 212 GB depending on your console. Clear space now so it can start right away.

slides.head: PS5: 12 a.m. Tuesday
slides.body: PS5 pre-loading starts Tuesday, November 10 at 12 a.m. in your local time zone, the moment Monday night turns into Tuesday.

slides.head: Xbox: Monday evening in the US
slides.body: Xbox pre-loading starts globally at 12 a.m. GMT on November 10. That's 7 p.m. Eastern, 6 p.m. Central or 4 p.m. Pacific on Monday, November 9.

slides.head: Buying the box? No disc
slides.body: Code-in-box copies are a download code, not a disc, so you'll still download the whole game. They arrive November 12, so you can't pre-load from one before then.

slides.head: November 19: play
slides.body: Launch day. Rockstar is also adding a free printable cover art poster and Leonida map to the official site that day.

title: COUNTING DOWN
TO NOV 19
slides.line: Follow so you don't miss launch week.
